gamerule.item_clumps.enable_clumping.des: When true, ground items will aggressively merge into mega-stacks to reduce entity lag. Default: true
gamerule.item_clumps.max_clump_size.desc: The hard cap on how many items can merge into a single entity. Prevents overflow issues. Default: 9999
gamerule.item_clumps.render_labels.descr: When true, renders a holographic count above item clumps larger than the label min count threshold. Default: true
gamerule.item_clumps.merge_radius.descri: The horizontal block radius items will search to merge with identical items. To match vanilla behavior, items will not merge if one is 1 block above or below the other. Default: 1
gamerule.item_clumps.label_min_count.des: Minimum item count before the clump label displays. Set to -1 to use the default vanilla stack limit. Default: -1
gamerule.item_clumps.enable_visual_scali: When true, item clumps scale in size logarithmically from 1.0x to 2.5x based on the item count. Default: true
config.item_clumps.title: Item Clumps Configuration
config.item_clumps.warning: Configure global default settings. Active worlds can be adjusted in-game via Game Rules.
config.item_clumps.enableClumping.descri: When true, ground items will aggressively merge into mega-stacks to reduce entity lag. Default: true

config.item_clumps.preClumpExplosions.de: When true, explosion block drops are consolidated before spawning to eliminate tick lag during massive blasts.
config.item_clumps.cullOccludedLabels.de: When true, floating clump labels behind solid opaque blocks are culled from rendering to eliminate visual clutter and save GPU draw calls.

config.item_clumps.hopperBatchSize.descr: Maximum number of items extracted per hopper pull when batch siphoning is active. Saturated by available slot capacity.
config.item_clumps.batchSiphonMinThresho: Minimum item count in a clump required to trigger batch siphoning. Clumps below this threshold siphon at vanilla rate (1 item).
